introSection.title: Complete UAE Market Access
paragraphs: Dubai Mainland Company Formation is your pathway to the complete UAE economy, allowing you to do business across Dubai, the Emirates, and internationally.
In addition to being a great gateway to doing business in Dubai, the Mainland gives you unparalleled access to customers, investors, and government contracts.

Whether you are starting your first business or expanding your global company's reach, setting up on Dubai Mainland is an amazing opportunity to gain access to the UAE economy. At Setup Zone Dubai, we help you set up your mainland company with complete compliance — business license, residency visa assistance, banking support, and post-setup services.

items.q: What is a mainland company in Dubai?
items.a: A mainland company in Dubai is a business licensed by the Department of Economy & Tourism (DET) with the full capability of operating in all parts of the UAE. Unlike Free Zone companies, a mainland company can trade with the local market directly, bid for government contracts, and lease office or retail space anywhere in Dubai.

items.q: Can expatriates fully own a mainland company in Dubai?
items.a: Yes. Since 2021, most mainland business activities allow 100% foreign ownership. Certain strategic activities may still require a local partner. We help you determine your specific case.

items.q: What are the benefits of setting up a mainland company rather than a Free Zone?
items.a: Mainland companies can trade directly with the UAE local market, bid for government contracts, operate across all 7 Emirates, hire unlimited employees based on office space, and have no geographical limitations.

items.q: How long does it take to get a mainland business license?
items.a: Typically 2-5 working days for license issuance, with the complete setup (including office lease and visa processing) taking 2-4 weeks.

items.q: What kind of licenses are available to form a mainland company?
items.a: Trade License, Professional/Service License, Industrial License, Tourism License, and E-commerce License — each suited to specific business activities.

items.q: Do I need office space to form a mainland company?
items.a: Yes. Mainland companies require a registered physical office (Ejari). We assist with finding the right office, warehouse, or showroom space for your business.

items.q: Can a mainland company do business and open branches in all emirates?
items.a: Yes. A mainland license allows you to operate freely across all 7 Emirates and open branches anywhere in the UAE without restrictions.

items.q: Do Dubai mainland companies have corporate tax implications?
items.a: Mainland companies are subject to UAE corporate tax regulations. At current thresholds, qualifying small businesses may benefit from 0% tax. We provide full compliance and VAT registration guidance.

items.q: What is the visa process for a mainland company?
items.a: We handle investor visas, partner visas, and employee visas — including Emirates ID, medical testing, and full PRO services. Visa quota depends on your office space size.

items.q: Why should I pick Setup Zone Dubai for mainland company registration?
items.a: We provide end-to-end support — activity classification, licensing, office lease, visa processing, bank account opening, and post-setup services including CRM, branding, and digital marketing.
